item.title: 2 killed in head-on crash on Groesbeck Highway in Clinton Township
item.description: A head-on crash on Groesbeck Highway in Clinton Township on Thursday killed two people.Police said a Dodge Caravan and Buick Encore were traveling south of Hall Road when they collided just before 4 p.m. Both drivers were pronounced dead at the scene, while a passenger in one of the vehicles suffered serious injuries.An investigation is ongoing. Anyone with information is asked to contact police at 586-493-7802.Watch FOX 2 News Live

item.title: ICE detention facility confirmed to be coming to Romulus, says state lawmaker
item.description: A building in Romulus rumored to be a future ICE detention facility has now been confirmed to be the case, according to a Michigan state senator. item.description: Two people have been arrested in connection with a shooting at a Christmas tree lighting ceremony back in November.It was the beginning of the holiday season, Nov. 23, and a Christmas tree lighting was taking place at Partridge Creek Mall.
